      • workOrdersForList

        public java.util.List<WorkOrder> workOrdersForList()
        The rows the work order page is built from. A cancelled order waits for nothing and is not work in hand, but it is kept rather than removed: the details dialog still offers to start it again, and that road goes through this list.

      • countOpenReclamations

        public static int countOpenReclamations(java.util.List<WorkOrder> orders)
        Reclamations not yet dealt with. A reclamation is an ordinary work order, so it waits until it is completed. Cancelled ones do not count, they wait for nothing.
